strings.Integrity_Blocked_NoApproval: A repair only starts with the record of an approved operation; none was present, so nothing was executed.
strings.Integrity_Blocked_NotElevated: Integrity repair requires administrator rights and was blocked.
strings.Integrity_Blocked_SfcRepairNotAutomated: Repairing system files with SFC is deliberately not automated: its exit codes are ambiguous and the repair cannot be verified here. Use DISM /RestoreHealth, which is verified by a second run.
strings.Integrity_Summary_NoCorruption: The component store reports no corruption.
strings.Integrity_Summary_NoViolations: SFC found no integrity violations (read-only verification).
strings.Integrity_Summary_NotPossible: SFC could not perform the requested operation. The output is in the evidence.
strings.Integrity_Summary_RepairCompleted: The repair completed; a verification run confirmed the new state.
strings.Integrity_Summary_RepairFailed: The repair did not complete successfully.

strings.Integrity_Summary_Repairable: Corruption was found and can be repaired.
strings.Integrity_Summary_Unknown: The tool output could not be interpreted; the result stays unknown.
strings.Integrity_Summary_ViolationsFound: SFC found integrity violations. No repair was executed - a repair needs an approved DISM operation.

strings.Maintenance_BrowserCache_Description: Temporary files of installed web browsers in the user profile. Cookies, sessions and passwords are never touched.
strings.Maintenance_BrowserCache_Reason: Only cache directories are removed; cookies and login data are excluded.
strings.Maintenance_CrashDumps_Description: Crash dump files of the local user profile. They are only removed, never uploaded.
strings.Maintenance_DeliveryOptimization_Descrip: Files of the Windows Delivery Optimisation cache. Windows rebuilds this cache as needed.
strings.Maintenance_DeliveryOptimization_Reason: Protected by Windows; clearing requires administrator rights and is verified afterwards.
strings.Maintenance_DryRun_Completed: Dry run finished - nothing was deleted.
strings.Maintenance_DryRun_Protected: {0} is protected and would not be touched.
strings.Maintenance_ErrorReports_Description: Error report archives created by Windows. They contain no user documents.
strings.Maintenance_InstallerCache_Description: Cached installer files of installed applications. Repair and uninstall may need them, so they are reported as optional.
strings.Maintenance_InstallerCache_Reason: Only the cache area is cleaned; uninstall information stays intact.
strings.Maintenance_Item_Result: {0} file(s) removed, {1} MB freed, {2} file(s) skipped
strings.Maintenance_Plan_Empty: No maintenance items are selectable on this machine.
strings.Maintenance_Prefetch_Description: Prefetch data that Windows uses to speed up program starts. Windows refills it automatically.
strings.Maintenance_Prefetch_Reason: Removal only affects the start-up acceleration, never installed programs.
strings.Maintenance_RecycleBin_Description: Contents of the recycle bin of the current user. Files in the recycle bin are recoverable until they are deleted here.
strings.Maintenance_RecycleBin_Reason: The deletion is final; a confirmation is therefore always required.
strings.Maintenance_Result_DryRun: Dry run: {0} item(s), {1} would be freed
strings.Maintenance_Result_Executed: {0} file(s) removed, {1} MB freed, {2} item(s) blocked
strings.Maintenance_ShaderCache_Description: Shader caches of graphics drivers. Games and applications rebuild them on first use.
strings.Maintenance_ShaderCache_Reason: Only cache files of the drivers are removed.
strings.Maintenance_TemporaryFiles_Description: Temporary files of the current user in the TEMP directory. Files in use are skipped.
strings.Maintenance_TemporaryFiles_Description_S: System temporary files in the Windows TEMP directory; administrator rights and extra care are required.
strings.Maintenance_ThumbnailCache_Description: Windows thumbnail and icon cache. Explorer rebuilds it automatically.
strings.Maintenance_ThumbnailCache_Reason: Only cached preview images are removed.
strings.Maintenance_Unknown_Description: This item has no description and is therefore not selectable.
strings.Maintenance_UpdateCache_Description: Cached update packages in the Windows Update download directory. Windows downloads them again if needed.
strings.Maintenance_UpdateCache_Reason: System directory; clearing requires administrator rights and is documented in the audit log.

strings.Module_Skipped_UpdatesDisabled: Module skipped: update checks are disabled in the settings.

strings.Optimization_ShaderCache_Why: Frees space; the first start of a game takes longer.

strings.Optimization_UpdateCache_Why: Frees space in the system directory.

strings.Overall_Healthy_WithSkips: No problems detected, but {0} module(s) were skipped.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_AmbiguousSegment: A path segment ends with a dot or a space. Windows strips those characters on access, so the path is not touched.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_Invalid: The path is not a valid path.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_IsAllowedRoot: The path is the allowed root itself and is not deleted.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_NoAllowedRoot: No allowed root is configured for this category.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_OutsideAllowedRoots: The path is outside every allowed root.
strings.PathGuard_Reason_Protected: The path is protected ({0}) and will not be touched.
strings.Preview_BiosVersion: Change to BIOS/UEFI version {0} - performed manually, never automatically.
strings.Preview_Reason_Unknown: Reason for the change not stated
strings.Problem_AcpiTemperature_Action: Install the vendor tool of the mainboard manufacturer for precise readings, or use the CPU package temperature of the processor.
strings.Problem_AcpiTemperature_Description: The ACPI thermal zone reports one value for a whole zone and is updated slowly. It is suitable for a trend, not for a precise core temperature reading.
strings.Problem_AcpiTemperature_Impact: The displayed temperature can differ noticeably from the real core temperature and must not be used to judge throttling.
strings.Problem_AcpiTemperature_Title: Temperature values come from an ACPI thermal zone, not from a core sensor
strings.Problem_BoardRevisionUnverified_Action: Read the revision off the mainboard itself (printed on the board) before any firmware step.
strings.Problem_BoardRevisionUnverified_Descript: Firmware files are valid for a specific board revision. Without a verified revision, no firmware file may be recommended.
strings.Problem_BoardRevisionUnverified_Impact: A firmware file for another revision can make the board unbootable.
strings.Problem_BoardRevisionUnverified_Title: The board revision could not be verified
strings.Problem_DefenderState_Action: Check the protection in Windows Security. This application only reports the state.
strings.Problem_DefenderState_Description: The reported protection state indicates that real-time protection or the signature state is not in order. The application never disables Defender and does not change these settings.
strings.Problem_DefenderState_Impact: Without active and up-to-date protection the machine is exposed to known threats.
strings.Problem_DefenderState_Title: Microsoft Defender is not fully active
strings.Problem_DeviceProblemCode_Action_Disable: The device is disabled. Enable it in Device Manager if it is needed.
strings.Problem_DeviceProblemCode_Action_Driver: Check the device in Device Manager and install the matching driver from the manufacturer source.
strings.Problem_DeviceProblemCode_Description: The device reports configuration manager error code {0}.
strings.Problem_DeviceProblemCode_Impact: The device may not work fully or at all.
strings.Problem_DriverInventoryEmpty_Action: Run the scan again as administrator and check the protocol for provider errors.
strings.Problem_DriverInventoryEmpty_Description: The driver inventory is empty, so no statement about driver health is possible.
strings.Problem_DriverInventoryEmpty_Impact: Driver problems cannot be detected in this state.
strings.Problem_DriverInventoryEmpty_Title: No driver inventory could be read
strings.Problem_DriverMissing_Action: Install a signed driver from the manufacturer source or via Windows Update.
strings.Problem_DriverMissing_Description: No driver information is available for this device.
strings.Problem_DriverMissing_Impact: The device may run with a generic driver and limited functionality.
strings.Problem_DriverSignatureUnknown_Action: Run the check as administrator to read the signature state.
strings.Problem_DriverSignatureUnknown_Descripti: The signature could not be read, for example because the driver store requires administrator rights. Unknown is not the same as valid.
strings.Problem_DriverSignatureUnknown_Impact: The integrity of these drivers cannot be confirmed with the available evidence.
strings.Problem_DriverSignatureUnknown_Title: The signature state of {0} driver file(s) is unknown
strings.Problem_DriverUnsigned_Action: Use a signed driver from the official manufacturer source.
strings.Problem_DriverUnsigned_Description: The signature of the installed driver could not be verified.
strings.Problem_DriverUnsigned_Impact: Unsigned drivers can destabilise the system.
strings.Problem_FirmwareCheckBlocked_Action: Use the official support page of the mainboard manufacturer and compare the revision yourself.
strings.Problem_FirmwareCheckBlocked_Impact: Without a verifiable source no firmware recommendation can be made.
strings.Problem_FirmwareUnknown_Action: Check the installed version in the BIOS/UEFI setup or with the vendor tool.
strings.Problem_FirmwareUnknown_Impact: No statement about an update is possible, which is why none is made.
strings.Problem_FirmwareUnknown_Title: The firmware state could not be determined
strings.Problem_FirmwareUpdate_Action: Follow the manufacturer instructions exactly and flash manually (BIOS Flashback or the vendor tool). This application never flashes firmware.
strings.Problem_FirmwareUpdate_Impact: Firmware updates can fix stability, compatibility and security problems, but a failed flash can make the board unbootable.
strings.Problem_FirmwareUpdate_Title: Firmware {0} is installed, {1} is offered by the manufacturer
strings.Problem_ModuleFailed_Action: Open the protocol, check the cause of the error and run the module again.
strings.Problem_ModuleFailed_Description: A diagnostic module did not complete. The result stays incomplete until the module runs successfully.
strings.Problem_ModuleFailed_Impact: Part of the system state was not analysed.
strings.Problem_PendingReboot_Action: Restart the machine and run the check again.
strings.Problem_PendingReboot_Description: Windows reports a pending restart. Checks after a pending restart can describe a mixed state.
strings.Problem_PendingReboot_Impact: Update and maintenance results can be incomplete until the restart has happened.
strings.Problem_ProtectedLocation_Action: Review the location manually; this application does not change it.
strings.Problem_ProtectedLocation_Description: A maintenance target lies in a protected location.
strings.Problem_ProtectedLocation_Impact: No automatic cleanup is possible here.
strings.Problem_ProviderUnavailable_Action: Check whether the required Windows service or tool is available, then run the scan again.
strings.Problem_ProviderUnavailable_Description: A data source of the diagnostic did not answer.
strings.Problem_ProviderUnavailable_Impact: Values of this source are shown as UNKNOWN instead of being guessed.
strings.Problem_ReadFailed_Action: Run the scan again; if the error repeats, check the event log for details.
strings.Problem_SensorUnavailable_Action: Install the vendor tool if the manufacturer provides one; ACPI thermal zones stay a limited source.
strings.Problem_SensorUnavailable_Description: No sensor provider could deliver a reading. No temperature or load value is therefore shown instead of an estimated one.
strings.Problem_SensorUnavailable_Impact: Temperature and load are shown as UNKNOWN.
strings.Problem_SmartUnavailable_Action: Run the application as administrator. If the values are still missing, the controller does not pass SMART data through.
strings.Problem_SmartUnavailable_Description: The device did not report SMART values to this session. Without this data, the condition of the drive cannot be judged.
strings.Problem_SmartUnavailable_Impact: An upcoming failure cannot be recognised in advance.
strings.Problem_SmartUnavailable_Title: SMART data of {0} is not available
strings.Problem_StorageCaution_Action: Back up important data and observe the values over the next days.
strings.Problem_StorageCaution_Description: The device reports a caution state (for example a reallocated sector or a degraded spare area).
strings.Problem_StorageCaution_Impact: The condition can get worse without any visible symptom.
strings.Problem_StorageFailing_Action: Back up your data now and replace the drive. Do not run storage maintenance on this device.
strings.Problem_StorageFailing_Description: The device itself reports that it is in a failing state.
strings.Problem_StorageFailing_Impact: Data loss is possible at any time.
strings.Problem_StorageWear_Action: Plan a replacement and make sure a current backup exists.
strings.Problem_StorageWear_Description: The wear indicator of the drive is close to its limit. The drive stays functional, but the remaining reserve is small.
strings.Problem_StorageWear_Impact: Write performance can drop and the risk of failure increases.
strings.Problem_Temperature_Action: Check the cooling (dust, fan speed, airflow) and the load profile before changing anything.
strings.Problem_Temperature_Description: The reading comes from a sensor with quality {0} (origin {1}).
strings.Problem_Temperature_Impact: Sustained high temperatures reduce the clock speed and the lifetime of the components.
strings.Problem_Unknown_Action: Review the finding and decide manually.
strings.Problem_Unknown_Description: A finding without a detailed description.
strings.Problem_VolumeCritical_Action: Free space on this volume (for example with the maintenance module after reviewing the preview).
strings.Problem_VolumeCritical_Description: Less than 5 % of the volume is free. Windows and applications need free space for updates and temporary files.
strings.Problem_VolumeCritical_Impact: Updates can fail and applications can report write errors.
strings.Problem_VolumeLow_Action: Review the maintenance preview and free space in a controlled step.
strings.Problem_VolumeLow_Description: Less than 10 % of the volume is free.
strings.Problem_VolumeLow_Impact: Temporary files and updates have little room left.
strings.Problem_WindowsCheck_Action: Open the Windows health page, review the evidence and decide whether a repair is needed.
strings.Problem_WindowsCheck_ActionElevated: This step needs administrator rights; the application blocks it without them.
strings.Problem_WindowsCheck_Impact: Windows may be in a state that needs a decision from you.
strings.Problem_WindowsUpdates_Action: Install the updates through Windows Update and restart if required.
strings.Problem_WindowsUpdates_Impact: Missing updates can leave known security gaps open.
strings.Problem_WorkloadDetected_Action: Close the workload if the change is really necessary - this application never ends it for you.
strings.Problem_WorkloadDetected_Description: {0} is running. Optimisation proposals are withheld while this workload is active.
strings.Protocol_ProviderUnavailable: Data source {0} is not available on this system.
strings.Protocol_ReadFailures: {0} hardware read(s) failed, {1} succeeded - the affected values stay UNKNOWN and are listed in the problem centre.
strings.Protocol_SnapshotNotStored: The snapshot could not be stored; the scan result remains valid for this session only.

strings.Report_Footer_Privacy: Contains local system information. No data was transmitted. Check before sharing.
strings.Report_NoSensors: No sensor readings are available on this system.
strings.Report_SimulationWarning: This report was created in simulation mode. All values are sample data, not measurements of this machine.

strings.Rollback_NotAvailable_NoArtefacts: The backup contains no restorable artefacts.

strings.Windows_Repair_Completed: Repair finished. The result is reported as the tool reported it.
strings.Windows_Repair_Pending: Waiting for your decision on the component store repair.
strings.Windows_Repair_Rejected: The component store repair was rejected. Nothing was executed.
strings.Windows_Repair_Risk: High: the component store is changed. The operation can take up to an hour and may require a restart. There is no rollback of a repair.
strings.Windows_Repair_What: DISM checks the component store against the Windows images and replaces damaged components from Windows Update or from a repair source.
strings.Windows_Repair_Why: Damaged components cause broken updates and system file errors. The check reported repairable corruption.
